title: Finish the permanent signals wallet index and resume Progress-217 cleanup in 1000-row batches
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Разрешаю. И уменьши порции для удаления
Что у нас дальше по этой задаче?

scope.goal: Finish the already approved permanent public.signals(trader_wallet, id) index in current master source, then delete the exact already approved 217 stopped unreferenced negative-Progress strategies and exactly attributable structured product history in independently committed batches of at most 1000 rows, without stopping the service or touching the six retained source/owner strategies.
inScope: Reuse without recalculation the exact immutable 217 UUID/code target set approved by RC-20260819-remove-217-unreferenced-negative-progress-strategies at sha256:f5f2af6d514277bfeacdc14c70e6efdcceb50173a240aeb538160149791ff0ac.

Preserve exactly the three excluded source strategies and their three retained LowerEnter owners named in the approved Progress-217 contract, including all their rows, references, and structured history.

Add the already approved permanent non-unique unfiltered B-tree index public.ix_signals_trader_wallet_id on public.signals(trader_wallet, id) to current master PostgresSchema and its focused StorageTests assertion; do not rebuild the already valid local or product indexes.
Complete the lifecycle/evidence of RC-20260820-add-signals-trader-wallet-index without changing its approved semantic payload.

Immediately before product deletion, rerun exact read-only identity, 217 membership/state, retained-reference, post-witness Paper/Live/run, active-Live, dependency-count, service-heartbeat/error, lock, and cleanup-marker gates.

Treat the current local database as verification-only because the 2026-08-29 read-only snapshot found zero of the exact 217 target rows; do not insert a marker or run cleanup DML locally unless a later fresh preview contradicts that zero count and the user approves the changed scope.
Execute product cleanup in FK-safe table order using independently committed, idempotent, restartable batches that affect at most 1000 physical rows per transaction.
Use only existing rows and the remaining exact target-owned rows as the durable resume point; do not add a generalized batching table, migration framework, trigger, or permanent progress object.

Before every next batch, verify an advancing healthy product heartbeat, empty service last_error, zero ungranted locks, unchanged exact target/retained identity guards, and the previous batch's exact affected count; stop on any deviation.
Delete only exactly attributable structured target history already enumerated by the approved Progress-217 contract, then delete the exact 217 strategy rows after all guarded dependencies reach zero.
Do not create a backup and do not stop or restart the service.

After the final batch, verify zero exact target strategies, zero exact structured residuals, cleanup marker present once, six retained strategy payloads unchanged, non-target strategy identities unchanged, service healthy, and no target reseed after at least two worker cycles.
Run focused index/catalog/cleanup tests, Release build, requirement gates, diff checks, and an independent semantic review before committing and pushing current master.
outOfScope: Recalculating Gross PnL, changing the 217 allowlist, deleting additional local-only strategies, or adding any target beyond the approved UUID/code pairs.
Deleting, updating, remapping, disabling, or otherwise modifying the three retained source strategies or their three retained LowerEnter owners.
Deleting shared/global rows without an exact target owner, shared compact-v2 dimension rows, unstructured global logs, or unrelated strategy/history data.
Stopping or restarting the service, cancelling orders, changing Live/Paper mode, or pausing unrelated strategies.
Creating a backup, dump, archive, restore point, database clone, generalized cleanup framework, or permanent batching/progress table.
Dropping, rebuilding, or changing either existing ix_signals_trader_wallet_id database index; both exact indexes were already verified valid/ready/live on 2026-08-29.
VACUUM FULL, pg_repack, REINDEX, physical database shrink, compact-v2 activation, or any separate storage-reclamation operation.
Any trading logic, strategy behavior, dashboard/report behavior, or unrelated source/documentation change.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact fixed 217 UUID/code product target set; product Stage-1 witness 2026-08-13T21:25:10.499570Z; maximum 1000 deleted physical rows per committed transaction; local current target count is zero and remains read-only.
scope.firstVerification: Verify current master/index-contract state and run bounded UTC read-only local/product snapshots for exact index catalogs, service health, exact 217 membership/control state, post-witness identities, active references, cleanup markers, and dependency scale before any governed edit or DELETE.

requirements.text: Finish the already approved permanent signals trader-wallet index in current master source without rebuilding either existing database index.
acceptanceCriteria: Current master PostgresSchema contains exactly one CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS ix_signals_trader_wallet_id ON signals(trader_wallet, id) definition.
A focused StorageTests assertion verifies the exact name, relation, non-unique B-tree key order, lack of predicate and INCLUDE columns, and concurrency.
Current local and product catalog checks remain exact and valid/ready/live; neither database index is rebuilt or replaced.
The identical exact 217-wallet product EXPLAIN uses ix_signals_trader_wallet_id and contains no sequential scan of public.signals.
Focused test and Release solution build pass with zero errors.

verification.command: Run the exact StorageTests index assertion and Release solution build with outputs under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Focused index test passes and Release build has zero errors.

verification.command: Read both exact index catalogs and run read-only EXPLAIN for the exact 217-wallet product lookup.
verification.expected: Both indexes retain the exact approved definition and product uses an index-driven plan without a signals sequential scan.

requirements.text: Delete the exact 217 product targets and their exactly attributable structured history in committed portions of at most 1000 rows.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh pre-mutation snapshot finds exactly 217 exact UUID/code product targets, all disabled, Live-off and permanently paused, with zero post-witness Paper/Live/run identities, zero active Live orders, zero active retained-owner references, zero ID/code collisions, and no cleanup marker.
Every deletion transaction affects at most 1000 physical rows, commits independently, is idempotent on retry, and leaves an auditable remaining-row count as its resume point.
FK-safe order and exact shared-owner guards prevent deleting any row still owned or referenced by a retained/non-target entity.
No batch begins unless the service heartbeat advances, last_error is empty, ungranted-lock count is zero, and retained/target identity gates still match the preview.
The exact 217 strategy rows are deleted only after every exact structured dependency and residual count reaches zero.
No local DML runs while the exact local target count remains zero.

verification.command: Run the exact read-only preflight, record per-relation counts and computed <=1000 batch counts, then execute and verify each independently committed product batch.
verification.expected: All committed batches satisfy the 1000-row maximum and every between-batch health/invariant gate passes.

verification.command: Run focused real-PostgreSQL fixtures for nominal multi-batch completion, retry/idempotency, forced rollback, shared-owner abort, active-reference abort, and retained-row preservation.
verification.expected: All cleanup fixtures pass, including multiple nonempty 1000-row pages and restart from committed partial progress.

requirements.text: Prove exact completion without changing retained or unrelated data and without stopping the service or creating a backup.
acceptanceCriteria: Post-mutation product checks find zero exact target strategies and zero exact structured target residuals, and the cleanup marker exists exactly once.
All six retained strategy full-row payloads and references equal their pre-mutation values; non-target strategy identity count and fingerprints are unchanged.
Product service remains Running/Live with advancing heartbeat, empty last_error and zero ungranted locks after final commit and after at least two worker cycles.
No target is reseeded and no target Paper/Live/run identity appears after completion.
No backup, service stop/restart, order cancellation, index rebuild, vacuum, or unrelated mutation occurs.

verification.command: Run immediate and two-worker-cycle product postchecks plus an independent exact retained/non-target comparison.
verification.expected: Target/residual counts are zero, marker count is one, retained/non-target fingerprints match, and service health remains normal.

verification.command: Compare both verbatim continuation prompts, this approved contract, existing approved target contracts, actual diff/commands and all test/runtime evidence; run WorkingTree/Staged gates and diff checks.
verification.expected: Independent semantic review passes with no finding and all mechanical gates pass before commit/push.

deviations.text: Replace the previously approved one-transaction-per-database Progress-217 deletion with independently committed batches of at most 1000 physical rows on product.
deviations.impact: The cleanup is restartable and reduces sustained lock/load impact, but the product database can temporarily contain partially removed target history between successful batches. Exact stopped-target, FK-order, shared-owner, health, and residual gates protect retained data; there is no global rollback across already committed batches and no backup by explicit user choice.
